headline: Compuage Infocom Limited: 26th Committee of Creditors Meeting Intimation
sum: Compuage Infocom Limited notified the NSE of its 26th Committee of Creditors (CoC) meeting scheduled for 24 June 2026 as part of its ongoing Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process (CIRP). The intimation indicates continued progression through the insolvency framework with creditor engagement ongoing.
detail: Compuage Infocom Limited, a technology sector entity, remains under CIRP and has convened its 26th CoC meeting. The high number of CoC meetings suggests either multiple resolution plans tabled and rejected, or creditor disagreements on valuation and recovery terms.
